environment: Local Windows Prometheus/Grafana scraping the public Lightsail endpoint over HTTPS; no additional AWS service created

trafficTest.description: Controlled synthetic traffic; GET /health (200) and a non-existent route (404), not passenger traffic
trafficTest.note: Prometheus rates use a rolling five-minute window over counters from the public container. The window includes controlled synthetic 404 tests, health checks and prior validation requests; it is not representative passenger traffic.
